name: Gleaning Our Future
summary: Prospector Whelgar sees a way to learn more from the Goaz Stone. Four larger golems bear names that match its missing pieces.

sections.title: Four Inscriptions
sections.body: You've found missing pieces of the Goaz Stone. Prospector Whelgar points to four larger golems named Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru. He asks you to use the stone near each one, then bring their hearts back. He hopes they will reveal more of its markings.

sections.title: Faint Words
sections.body: When Prospector Whelgar brings the hearts close to the Goaz Stone, new writing shimmers into view: “Curse of Flesh... they will fail.” He cannot make out what the words mean. He wants to take the stone somewhere safe for further study.

faq.q: What does Whelgar want me to bring back?
faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar asks you to use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru, then bring back their hearts.

aliases: where are ados modr golm neru
faq.answer: Ados is at the Dragonmaw Gates near Grim Batol. Modr is just outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru is behind Direforge Hill to the northeast.

faq.q: Why does Whelgar want the golem hearts?
faq.answer: The golems bear inscriptions that match missing pieces of the Goaz Stone. Whelgar hopes their hearts will reveal more of its markings.

faq.q: What does Whelgar think of the golems?
faq.answer: Whelgar suspects the constructs will be tougher than the warder.

attribution: In-game quest text: Gleaning Our Future
